_comment: Manual location overrides for institutions that cannot be auto-geocoded (e.g. private companies, research centres with no OSM/Wikidata entry). Each affiliation_key must be the ascii_key() of the affiliation string exactly as it appears in the eCOST export. City-level coordinates are used when a precise building location is unavailable.

overrides._note: Bitsphi Diagnosis — private neurotech company, no OSM/Wikidata entry. City-level: Zaragoza, Spain.
Moscow State University of Psychology and Education (МГППУ) — typo variant 'Pychology' in eCOST export. Coordinates: main campus, Sretenka, Moscow.
